forbidden_classes_observed: none: no LLM-invented domains, no search-engine roots, no blog/forum/mirror roots, no unparented sources. The single derivation-pattern guess (S019 manpage URL) 404'd and was retained as a failed record, not replaced by invention.
promotion_rule: A metadata/child/typed reference is promoted only with (a) a deterministic parent chain to seed evidence and (b) corroboration: namespace/version match plus an independent advisory typing, VendorID match, or in-stanza/vendor-stamp match. Otherwise CANDIDATE_ONLY. L4/L5-content sources stay CANDIDATE_ONLY in ARM_A (traversal recorded, content uninterpreted) to enforce arm isolation.
